title: Meet the Knowledge Portal team at ADA!
summary: If you're attending the American Diabetes Association 84th Scientific Sessions, please stop by booth #549 to learn about the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal and meet the team!
bodyHtml: Will you be at #ADA2024? If so, please come visit booth #549 in the exhibit hall. We'd love to meet you and get your feedback on the CMDKP and its component community portals for types 1 and 2 diabetes, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease, and sleep disorders. We'll be there from 10am-4pm on Saturday June 22 and Sunday June 23, and from 10am-2pm on Monday June 24.
